obligations.summary: High-risk AI systems must be designed and developed to ensure sufficient transparency so that deployers can interpret the system's output and use it appropriately.

High-risk AI systems must be accompanied by instructions for use in an appropriate digital format (or otherwise) that are concise, complete, correct, clear, relevant, accessible and comprehensible to deployers.
Instructions for use must contain the identity and contact details of the provider and, where applicable, of its authorised representative.

Instructions for use must describe the characteristics, capabilities and limitations of the high-risk AI system, including its intended purpose, accuracy metrics, robustness, cybersecurity levels, known foreseeable risks to health, safety or fundamental rights, explainability capabilities, performance on specific persons or groups, and input data specifications.
exceptions: Information on technical explainability capabilities is required only where applicable.
Performance regarding specific persons or groups is required only when appropriate.
Input data specifications are required only when appropriate and taking into account the intended purpose.

obligations.summary: Instructions for use must describe any predetermined changes to the high-risk AI system and its performance that were established by the provider at the time of the initial conformity assessment.
exceptions: This requirement applies only if such predetermined changes exist.

obligations.summary: Instructions for use must include information on human oversight measures, including technical measures put in place to facilitate the interpretation of system outputs by deployers.

Instructions for use must specify the computational and hardware resources needed, the expected lifetime of the high-risk AI system, and any necessary maintenance and care measures — including frequency of software updates — to ensure proper functioning.
Where relevant, instructions for use must describe the mechanisms within the high-risk AI system that allow deployers to properly collect, store and interpret logs.
exceptions: This requirement applies only where relevant.
